name: Cheesy Chicken & Portobello Burger with Sun-Dried Tomato Mixed Greens

cookwares.name: grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince garlic. Place in a large bowl along with the chicken, bread crumbs, mayo, Worcestershire, and spices. Mix with your hands until well combined; set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
0.68 kg ground chicken
¾ cup panko bread crumbs
2 tbsp mayonnaise
1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce
1 tbsp Italian seasoning
¾ tsp rosemary, dried
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry portobello mushrooms. Remove stems and carefully scrape out the gills. Rub with oil, then season with salt and pepper; place cap-side down on a large plate.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 caps portobello mushrooms
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Using your hands, divide chicken mixture between the insides of mushrooms, spreading evenly to the edges. Gently press to adhere.
Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet over medium-high heat.
While the pan heats up, thinly slice cheese.
Once the pan is hot, coat with oil. Working in batches if necessary, add burger patties, chicken-side down and cook, undisturbed, until the chicken is golden brown and cooked through, 4-5 minutes.
Flip patties, top with cheese, and cook until mushrooms are golden brown and fork-tender, 6-8 minutes more. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, peel, halve, and mince onion. Place in a clean large bowl.
Roughly chop sun-dried tomatoes. Add to the bowl with the onion along with oil, vinegar, honey, Dijon, salt, and pepper. Whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
18 sun-dried tomatoes, oil-packed
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
2 tbsp red wine vinegar
1 tbsp honey
1 tbsp Dijon mustard
½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the mixed greens (skip this step if they came pre-washed). Add to the bowl with the dressing and toss to combine the salad.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ (142 g) pkgs spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.primary_message: Spread mayo over the bottom half of each bun; top with cheesy burger patties and a small handful of salad. Close with the top half of each bun. Serve with remaining salad on the side and enjoy!
